description:
Navigate to the 'Binary Bulbs' activity in GCompris and complete at least 3 levels. 

1. From the main menu, find the 'Binary Bulbs' activity. It is typically located in the Science/Experimental category (flask icon) or Computer Discovery category.
2. Open the activity. You will see a decimal number and a row of light bulbs representing binary bits (1, 2, 4, 8, ...).
3. Click the bulbs to toggle them on/off until their sum equals the displayed decimal number.
4. Complete at least 3 levels successfully.
5. Once you have completed 3 levels, take a screenshot of the activity and save it to '/tmp/binary_bulb_final.png' using the command: `scrot /tmp/binary_bulb_final.png`.
